description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write). Publish one of your drafts to techfabric.com, only after the engineer confirms, once check_draft with the id has passed on exactly the saved text. The first call publishes nothing: it asks the engineer by a form in their client, or returns a one-time confirmation that you send back on a second call only after their yes. Never in a scheduled or unattended run. override names wording checks the engineer chooses to publish past (never the hard set, the fact-check, slop, quality, opening or ending). confirm_via "token": always return the one-time confirmation instead of a form, for a UI that asks the engineer itself.

confirm_via.description: How the engineer is asked. Default: elicitation where the client supports it. "token": the first call returns a one-time confirmation instead, for a UI (an MCP App's Publish button) that asks the engineer itself

confirmation.description: Only on the second call: the confirmation the first call returned, sent back after the engineer said yes

id.description: The idea id of your own draft

override.description: Publish anyway: the failing check ids (as check_draft reports them, such as gate:buyer) the engineer chooses to publish past. Only wording and style checks; the hard set (the page working, claims, our own spend, secrets) always has to pass. Send the same list on the confirming call

name: publish_draft

confirmation.description: One-time: send it back to publish_draft only after the engineer says yes. Never show it to them

details.description: Where and under whose byline it goes live: show it beside the question if they ask

next_action.description: The one next step. Do what instruction says; call is the tool and the arguments the server already knows

question.description: What to ask the engineer, word for word: "Publish '<title>' now? (yes/no)", then anything else they are agreeing to

reasked.description: True when the confirmation sent no longer fitted (it lapsed, or the text or its checks moved): ask this fresh question instead, plainly

title: Publish your draft
